about.text: Skimmed milk with more than half its water evaporated off and sterilised in the can, with no more than 1 % fat; used in coffee and for cooking.

facts.v: 21 CFR 131.132: partial removal of water only from skim milk; at least 20 % total milk solids, at most 0.5 % milkfat unless labelled
Vitamins A and D must be added: 25 IU D and at least 125 IU A per fluid ounce
